text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Haa, haa... phew...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing training with Air Shakur, 
I happened to glance over and caught sight 
of Dantsu Flame running all by herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was usually so full of energy, but she 
seemed to have a rather gloomy 
expression...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Leave it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Stop poking your nose into every little 
thing. ...Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Urged on, I nod. —And yet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just a coincidence, once it 
catches your eye, you can't help but be 
curious.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ? Ah, you're...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for worrying you. Ahaha, geez, I'm 
embarrassing myself. Could you tell just 
by looking at my face?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she hesitated for a moment, Dantsu 
Flame told me the reason for her downcast 
mood. That reason was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In her upcoming race, she had learned that 
the rival she longed to defeat would not 
be running.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
There are plenty of other Umamusume who 
want to win too. The same goes for the 
others running in this race.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to be the leading lady. A 
leading lady who shines brilliantly among 
all the many Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I kind of understand what she's trying to 
say. If even one strong rival drops out, 
then winning the spotlight like that would 
be...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I understand logically, but... I really 
thought I could compete with those girls. 
It just leaves me feeling so conflicted.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
This won't do, acting like this... It's 
rude to the other runners too. I've got to 
reset my mind!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief. She's at it again...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If ya ain't gonna run, yer just in the 
way.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur swept past the stationary 
Dantsu Flame like a gust of wind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame reflexively chased after Air 
Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ha! Running like a wet blanket won't even 
get you a background role, let alone the 
lead!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh...! Haaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two suddenly began running as if it 
were a real race. In response to Air 
Shakur's provocative words, Dantsu Flame 
answered with her stride.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah... hah... Shakur-chan, what's got 
into you all of a sudden...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Haah... haah... Shut up, this is all your 
fault anyway.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Aren't rivals generally supposed to be 
drawn to the protagonist?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"If I can't run like that, I won't be able 
to drag it outta them, will I?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Shakur-chan...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Nobody wants to follow a lead actor who 
lacks charm...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ………… Yeah, I see. You're right.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: —First, I have to shine brightly myself!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Thanks, Shakur-chan. I don't want to 
lose to you either.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Ha, bark all you want.
